verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs confirm that marketers create audiences and then connect them to outputs for activation. The homepage says users can describe an audience and the product suggests the logic, which implies a no-SQL path. Nothing in the pack documents a visual builder, the trait and behavior criteria, or a size estimate before activation. missing for 10: documented visual drag-and-drop builder, explicit trait/behavioral criteria support, estimated audience size preview before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use
